issue_sampling: One UTC issue date per seven days
selection: Validation MAE per target and forecast window; no test-driven selection
intervals: Quantiles 0.1, 0.5, 0.9 with nonnegative validation residual expansion; correlated windows and distribution shift preclude a finite-sample coverage guarantee
spatial_holdout: 25% of sampled MERRA-2 cells never enter training or validation
temperature_postprocessing: Minimum <= mean <= maximum, applied to point estimates and corresponding quantiles
inputs: Observed daily environmental conditions and calendar only; no future weather forecasts or LANDFIRE layers
